package internalapi

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"net/http"
)

type NextActionGetter interface {
	Handle(context.Context, string) (domain.StudentNextAction, error)
}

func (h *Handler) GetNextAction(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	if h.NextAction == nil {
		http.Error(w, "next action unavailable", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	result, err := h.NextAction.Handle(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"))
	if err != nil {
		writeInternalJourneyError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(result)
}
